text:
maria: Heads-up — product wants an APAC+EU turnup plan for the Q3 pilot feature (multi-region autocomplete) and they're asking for firm GPU commitments by next week.
sam: Yep, product here. Acme and Nimbly told us they'll go live with the beta if we can guarantee <120ms p99 in EU and APAC and provide private Dedicated pools for the enterprise tier.
ajay: Quick reality check — to hit p99 <120ms with current model (redwood/opt-7b) and expected traffic profile we need contiguous H100-equivalent capacity per region. Ballpark: EU 6 GPUs, APAC 4 GPUs for initial 20k qps/day tests.
noah: Vendor lead times are still 8–12 weeks for new rack orders in EU. We can ship APAC faster via partner colo but it's spotty on guaranteed SKUs.
lina: Finance — reserved commits are limited. We can reallocate 3 H100-equivalents from lower-priority experiments next quarter but need strong customer T&Cs to justify cost.
maria: Options on the table: 1) staggered rollouts (EU later), 2) burst/buffer with spot H100s + fallback to smaller quantized variant, 3) take Dedicated from cloud provider for short term (higher $).
sam: Can we do staggered? Acme expects EU first but would accept APAC pilot. They'd prefer private Dedicated though.
ajay: Technical tradeoffs: fallback to quantized 4-bit variant increases latency slightly but reduces GPU need by ~30%. Example calc:
```
model = opt-7b
baseline_throughput ~= 250 tokens/s per H100
expected_tokens/session ~= 120
sessions/day ~= 10k -> concurrent ~= ~14
=> safe_guarantee ~= 1.5x -> GPUs_needed ~= 4 (APAC) / 6 (EU)
quantized reduces per-GPU memory so you can squeeze 1.3x more throughput
```
maria: Also need to consider Private deployment isolation: HSM/KMS integrations will add ~1 week of infra config per customer and audit windows.
noah: Ops note: if we use cloud Dedicated for 8 weeks, we can negotiate a short-term SLA but the onboarding cost is non-trivial (networking, IAM, monitoring).
lina: If we attach a short-term premium to the pilot (cost-recovery), finance will approve one-off Dedicated spend. Otherwise we need headcount/commit tradeoffs.
sam: Product can push a partial launch: APAC public hosted + EU private for Acme only. That reduces immediate EU GPU ask by 60%.
maria: Proposal: commit to APAC 4 GPUs by week 2 (spot+partner colo fallback), offer EU private for Acme using cloud Dedicated for 8 weeks while procurement completes. Meanwhile ramp on quantized variant for public hosted.
ajay: I'll draft perf targets and fallback routing policy (priority: private Dedicated -> cloud Dedicated -> quantized hosted -> degraded model). Put it in a quick PR.
deploy-bot: Reminder: procurement request template is available at /procurement/requests.earliest_delivery_estimate = 2023450000
noah: I'll open the colo/partner tickets and check provider stock tomorrow.
lina: Add me to the PR for the cost justification.
sam: Great — agree with staggered approach. Can the infra team mark EU Dedicated as "acme-only" in the rollout plan so we can communicate ETA to customers?
maria: yes, will add rollout tags and a canary date. Next step: infra to confirm APAC partner availability by EOD tomorrow, procurement to submit cloud Dedicated quote by Friday.
sam: Thanks all. I'll update Acme and Nimbly with the phased plan later today. :white_check_mark:
